_purpose: A frozen subset of the shipped Risk Analysis catalog as template rows (Get-SITemplateRows, rareport), for the report designer tests (#274). catalog.expected.yaml is what the materialiser wrote for these rows BEFORE #274 (commit 4d0255379) -- an unchanged catalog must still materialise to exactly those bytes.

{
      "ReportName": "Identity_NoMFA_Detailed",
      "ReportPurpose": "Per-row detail view for Identity_AnyUser_NoMFA_Summary. All enabled users with no MFA registration, across all tiers. Excludes accounts created within the last 7 days. Severity scales with tier. Detailed emits one row per affected asset (PrimaryEntityId-keyed), suitable for ticket creation, remediation tracking, and per-asset evidence. Per-identity detail view for AnyUser NoMFA Summary.",
      "SecurityDomain": "Identity",
      "CategoryInputName": "Category",
      "SubcategoryInputName": "Subcategory",
      "ConfigurationIdInputName": "ConfigurationId",
      "SecuritySeverityInputName": "SecuritySeverity",
      "CriticalityTierLevelInputName": "CriticalityTierLevel",
      "RiskConsequenceScoreOutputName": "RiskConsequenceScore",
      "RiskProbabilityScoreOutputName": "RiskProbabilityScore",
      "RiskScoreOutputName": "RiskScoreTotal",
      "CriticalityTierLevelScope": [
        "Critical - tier 0",
        "High - tier 1",
        "Medium - tier 2",
        "Low - tier 3"
      ],
      "SecuritySeverityScope": [
        "Very High",
        "High",
        "Medium-High",
        "Medium",
        "Low"
      ],
      "OutputPropertyOrder": [
        "SecurityDomain",
        "Category",
        "Subcategory",
        "ConfigurationName",
        "ConfigurationId",
        "AssetName",
        "AssetId",
        "AssetType",
        "Impact",
        "SecuritySeverity",
        "CriticalityTier",
        "CriticalityTierLevel",
        "RiskFactor_Consequence_Detailed",
        "RiskFactor_Consequence",
        "RiskFactor_Probability_Detailed",
        "RiskFactor_Probability",
        "RiskConsequenceScore",
        "RiskProbabilityScore",
        "RiskScoreTotal",
        "RiskScore_Weight_Detailed",
        "RiskScore_Weight_Factor",
        "RiskScoreTotal_Weighted",
        "RiskRating",
        "cmdbId",
        "cmdbName",
        "cmdbCriticality",
        "cmdbDataSensitivity",
        "MoreDetails",
        "AssetDetectedInReportName"
      ],
      "SortBy": [
        "RiskScoreTotal_Weighted"
      ],
      "ReportQuery": [
        "// CL asset-metadata lookup for the identity (engine-substitution friendly).
// EG / MDI / SignInLogs / etc. drive ALL detection + scoring; CL adds only cmdb fields.
let _IdentityCmdb =
    SI_Identity_Profile_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(8d)
    | summarize arg_max(CollectionTime, *) by PrimaryEntityId
    // RA-1 -- BACKFILL THE v3 IDENTITY WITHOUT MOVING THE ROW ABOVE.
    // Both editions write this table and v2.2 emits no SI_ columns, so the arg_max winner is
    // frequently a v2.2 row and the identity comes back EMPTY for an asset that plainly has
    // one. Measured 2026-08-29 over ago(8d): SI_Azure_Profile_CL 9698 rows carried SI_AssetId
    // on 3502, but after this arg_max only 1 of 782 winners did.
    // 🔒 THE ROW IS DELIBERATELY NOT RE-RANKED. This binding also carries Tier, cmdb* and
    // IsExcludedByTag, and Tier drives CriticalityTier which drives the risk score -- preferring
    // a v3 row here would move scores across the whole catalog. Same row as before -- only the
    // identity is filled, from the newest row that actually has one.
    // 📌 The lookup is one row per PrimaryEntityId, so the leftouter cannot fan out. Verified:
    // row count unchanged, Tier still set on every row, SI_AssetId 425 -> 771 of 782 (azure).
    | join kind=leftouter (
          SI_Identity_Profile_CL
          | where TimeGenerated > ago(8d)
          | where isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetId", "")))
          | summarize arg_max(CollectionTime, *) by PrimaryEntityId
          | project _v3Pk = PrimaryEntityId,
                    _v3Name = tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetName", "")),
                    _v3Id   = tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetId", ""))
      ) on $left.PrimaryEntityId == $right._v3Pk
    | extend SI_AssetName = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetName", "")), _v3Name)
    | extend SI_AssetId   = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetId", "")),   _v3Id)
    | project-away _v3Pk, _v3Name, _v3Id
    | project
        _si_PrimaryEntityId    = tostring(PrimaryEntityId),
        _si_cmdbName           = tostring(column_ifexists("cmdbName", "")),
        _si_cmdbId             = tostring(column_ifexists("cmdbId", "")),
        _si_cmdbCriticality    = tostring(column_ifexists("cmdbCriticality", "")),
        _si_cmdbDataSensitivity = tostring(column_ifexists("cmdbDataSensitivity", "")),
          AssetName_From_CL      = iif(isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetName", ""))), tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetName", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AssetName", ""))),
          AssetId_From_CL        = iif(isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetId", ""))), tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetId", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AssetId", ""))),
          AssetType_From_CL      = tostring(column_ifexists("AssetType", ""))
    | where isnotempty(_si_PrimaryEntityId);

SI_Identity_Profile_CL
| where CollectionTime == toscalar(SI_Identity_Profile_CL | summarize V3 = maxif(CollectionTime, isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetId", "")))), Any = max(CollectionTime) | project coalesce(V3, Any))
| summarize arg_max(CollectionTime, *) by PrimaryEntityId
| extend CreatedDays = datetime_diff('day', now(), todatetime(CreatedDateTime))
| extend HasPermanentPrivilegedRole = (coalesce(EntraRolesPermanentVerdict_Tier, 99) <= 1)
| extend IsPrivileged = (coalesce(EntraRolesPermanentVerdict_Tier, 99) <= 1 or coalesce(EntraRolesEligibleVerdict_Tier, 99) <= 1)
| extend IsPrivilegedEligible = (coalesce(EntraRolesEligibleVerdict_Tier, 99) <= 1)
| where ObjectType == "User"
| where AccountEnabled == true
| where MfaIsRegistered == false
| where CreatedDays > 7
| extend CSA_AssetTier = toint(extract(@'"AssetTier"\s*:\s*"tier-(\d)"', 1, tostring(CSA)))
| extend CriticalityTier = toint(coalesce(Tier, 2))
| extend CriticalityTierLevel =
    case(CriticalityTier == 0, "Critical - tier 0", CriticalityTier == 1, "High - tier 1",
         CriticalityTier == 2, "Medium - tier 2",   CriticalityTier == 3, "Low - tier 3", "Low - tier 3")
| extend SecuritySeverity = case(CriticalityTier == 0, "Very High", CriticalityTier == 1, "High", CriticalityTier == 2, "Medium", "Low")
| extend RF_P_Privileged = iff(IsPrivileged == true, 1, 0)
| extend RF_P_StaleLogin = iff(LastSignInDays > 90 or LastSignInDays == -1, 1, 0)
| extend RiskFactor_Consequence = case(CriticalityTier == 0, 3, CriticalityTier == 1, 2, 1)
| extend RiskFactor_Probability = RF_P_Privileged + RF_P_StaleLogin
| extend RiskFactor_Probability_Detailed = strcat_array(array_concat(
    iff(RF_P_Privileged == 1,  dynamic(["PrivilegedRole"]), dynamic([])),
    iff(RF_P_StaleLogin == 1,  dynamic(["StaleLastLogin"]), dynamic([]))), ";")
| extend RiskFactor_Probability_DetailedScore =
    strcat("PrivilegedRole=", tostring(RF_P_Privileged), ";StaleLastLogin=", tostring(RF_P_StaleLogin))
| extend SecurityDomain    = "Identity"
| extend Category          = "Authentication"
| extend Subcategory       = "MFA Registration"
| extend ConfigurationName = "User missing MFA registration"
| extend ConfigurationId   = "IDENTITY-MFA-002"
// CL identity-metadata enrichment (cmdb only). Detection logic above is unchanged.
| extend DeviceKey = PrimaryEntityId
//__BUCKET_FILTER_BEGIN__
| where 1 == 1
//__BUCKET_FILTER_END__
| join kind=leftouter (_IdentityCmdb) on $left.PrimaryEntityId == $right._si_PrimaryEntityId
| extend AssetName = coalesce(column_ifexists("SI_AssetName", ""), column_ifexists("AssetName", ""), column_ifexists("AssetName_From_CL", ""), strcat_array(column_ifexists("SourceAssets_Path", dynamic([])), "; "), strcat_array(column_ifexists("TargetAssets_Path", dynamic([])), "; "), column_ifexists("ImpactedAssets", ""))
| extend AssetId   = coalesce(column_ifexists("SI_AssetId", ""), column_ifexists("AssetId", ""),   column_ifexists("AssetId_From_CL", ""),   column_ifexists("PrimaryEntityId", ""))
| extend AssetType = coalesce(column_ifexists("AssetType", ""), column_ifexists("AssetType_From_CL", ""), column_ifexists("ObjectType", ""), "Identity")
| extend
    cmdbId            = _si_cmdbId,
    cmdbName            = _si_cmdbName,
    cmdbCriticality     = _si_cmdbCriticality,
    cmdbDataSensitivity = _si_cmdbDataSensitivity
//__WEIGHTED_FACTORS_BEGIN__
| extend RiskScore_Weight_Detailed = iff(isnotempty(cmdbCriticality), strcat("cmdbCriticality=", tostring(cmdbCriticality)), "")
| extend RiskScore_Weight_Factor   = 100
| extend RiskFactor_Weight         = 100
//__WEIGHTED_FACTORS_END__
        | project
          SecurityDomain,
          Category,
          Subcategory,
          ConfigurationName,
          ConfigurationId,
          AssetName,
          AssetId,
          AssetType,
          SecuritySeverity,
          CriticalityTier,
          CriticalityTierLevel,
          DisplayName,
          Upn,
          PrimaryEntityId,
          Department,
          Tier,
          IsPrivileged,
          HasPermanentPrivilegedRole,
          IsPrivilegedEligible,
          MfaIsRegistered,
          AccountEnabled,
          LastSignInDays,
          LastSignInDateTime,
          CreatedDays,
          EntraRoles_Permanent,
          NestedGroups,
          RiskFactor_Consequence,
          RiskFactor_Probability,
          RiskFactor_Probability_Detailed,
          cmdbId,
          cmdbName,
          cmdbCriticality,
          cmdbDataSensitivity,
          RiskScore_Weight_Detailed,
          RiskScore_Weight_Factor
        | order by RiskScore_Weight_Factor desc, CriticalityTier asc"
      ]
    }

{
      "ReportName": "Identity_GuestWithPrivilegedRole_Detailed",
      "ReportPurpose": "B2B Guest users (UserType=Guest) holding ANY Entra role -- guests should never have privileged roles.",
      "SecurityDomain": "Identity",
      "CategoryInputName": "Category",
      "SubcategoryInputName": "Subcategory",
      "ConfigurationIdInputName": "ConfigurationId",
      "SecuritySeverityInputName": "SecuritySeverity",

      "RiskConsequenceScoreOutputName": "RiskConsequenceScore",
      "RiskProbabilityScoreOutputName": "RiskProbabilityScore",

      "CriticalityTierLevelScope": [
        "Critical - tier 0",
        "High - tier 1",

      "ReportQuery": [
        "SI_Identity_Profile_CL\n| where TimeGenerated > ago(8d)\n| summarize arg_max(CollectionTime, *) by PrimaryEntityId\n        | extend cmdbId               = tostring(column_ifexists('cmdbId', ''))\n        | extend cmdbName             = tostring(column_ifexists('cmdbName', ''))\n        | extend cmdbCriticality      = tostring(column_ifexists('cmdbCriticality', ''))\n        | extend cmdbDataSensitivity  = tostring(column_ifexists('cmdbDataSensitivity', ''))\n        | extend CmdbMatchPhase           = tostring(column_ifexists('CmdbMatchPhase', ''))\n        | extend CmdbMatchState           = tostring(column_ifexists('CmdbMatchState', ''))   // __SI_CMDB_DEFENSIVE__\n| where IsExternalIdentity == true\n| where (array_length(todynamic(EntraRoles_Permanent)) > 0) or (array_length(todynamic(EntraRoles_Eligible)) > 0)\n| extend MoreInfoUrl = strcat(\"https://entra.microsoft.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_UsersAndTenants/UserProfileMenuBlade/~/AssignedRoles/userId/\", coalesce(EntityIds,Upn))\n| extend Links = dynamic_to_json(pack_array(\n    pack(\"label\", \"Guest user\",         \"url\", MoreInfoUrl),\n    pack(\"label\", \"External collaboration policy\", \"url\", \"https://entra.microsoft.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_IAM/CompanyRelationshipsMenuBlade/~/Settings\")))\n| extend DeviceKey = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists(\"AppId\",\"\")), tostring(column_ifexists(\"Upn\",\"\")), tostring(column_ifexists(\"DisplayName\",\"\")))\n        //__BUCKET_FILTER_BEGIN__\n        | where 1 == 1\n        //__BUCKET_FILTER_END__\n        | extend Impact                          = coalesce(toreal(column_ifexists(\"Impact\", real(null))), case(tolower(tostring(column_ifexists(\"Impact\", \"\"))) == \"critical\", 10.0, tolower(tostring(column_ifexists(\"Impact\", \"\"))) == \"very high\", 10.0, tolower(tostring(column_ifexists(\"Impact\", \"\"))) == \"high\", 8.0, tolower(tostring(column_ifexists(\"Impact\", \"\"))) == \"medium\", 5.0, tolower(tostring(column_ifexists(\"Impact\", \"\"))) == \"moderate\", 5.0, tolower(tostring(column_ifexists(\"Impact\", \"\"))) == \"low\", 2.0, tolower(tostring(column_ifexists(\"Impact\", \"\"))) == \"informational\", 1.0, tolower(tostring(column_ifexists(\"Impact\", \"\"))) == \"info\", 1.0, real(null)))\n        | extend SecuritySeverity                = case(toreal(Impact) >= 9, \"Very High\", toreal(Impact) >= 7, \"High\", toreal(Impact) >= 4, \"Medium\", toreal(Impact) >= 0.1, \"Low\", \"Low\")\n        | extend CriticalityTier                 = toint(coalesce(column_ifexists(\"Tier\", 999), 999))\n        | extend CriticalityTierLevel            = case(toint(CriticalityTier) == 0, \"Critical - tier 0\", toint(CriticalityTier) == 1, \"High - tier 1\", toint(CriticalityTier) == 2, \"Medium - tier 2\", toint(CriticalityTier) == 3, \"Low - tier 3\", \"Low - tier 3\")\n        | extend RiskFactor_Consequence          = 0   // engine overrides this from RiskFactor_Consequence_Detailed token count (or 0 if empty) -- schema scaffolding only\n        | extend RiskFactor_Probability          = toint(iff(tobool(column_ifexists(\"IsExternalIdentity\", false)) == true, 1, 0)) + toint(iff(tobool(column_ifexists(\"IsCmdbOrphan\", false)) == true, 1, 0))\n        | extend RiskFactor_Probability_Detailed = strcat_array(pack_array(iff(tobool(column_ifexists(\"IsExternalIdentity\", false)) == true, \"IsExternalIdentity\", \"\"), iff(tobool(column_ifexists(\"IsCmdbOrphan\", false)) == true, \"IsCmdbOrphan\", \"\")), \", \")\n        | extend RiskFactor_Weight               = case(tostring(column_ifexists(\"cmdbCriticality\",\"\")) == \"Critical\", 2.0, tostring(column_ifexists(\"cmdbCriticality\",\"\")) == \"High\", 1.5, tostring(column_ifexists(\"cmdbCriticality\",\"\")) == \"Medium\", 1.2, tostring(column_ifexists(\"cmdbCriticality\",\"\")) == \"Low\", 1.05, 1.0)\n        | extend Category = case(\n            isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists(\"IdentityType\", \"\"))), tostring(column_ifexists(\"IdentityType\", \"\")),\n            isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists(\"SecurityPrincipalType\", \"\"))), tostring(column_ifexists(\"SecurityPrincipalType\", \"\")),\n            isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists(\"ObjectType\", \"\"))), tostring(column_ifexists(\"ObjectType\", \"\")),\n            \"\")\n        | extend Subcategory = case(\n            isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists(\"ServicePrincipalType\", \"\"))), tostring(column_ifexists(\"ServicePrincipalType\", \"\")),\n            isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists(\"MiAccountType\", \"\"))), tostring(column_ifexists(\"MiAccountType\", \"\")),\n            isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists(\"UserType\", \"\"))), tostring(column_ifexists(\"UserType\", \"\")),\n            isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists(\"EmployeeType\", \"\"))), tostring(column_ifexists(\"EmployeeType\", \"\")),\n            isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists(\"CreationType\", \"\"))), tostring(column_ifexists(\"CreationType\", \"\")),\n            \"\")\n        // __SI_CANONICAL__\n//__WEIGHTED_FACTORS_BEGIN__\n| extend RiskScore_Weight_Detailed = \"\"\n| extend RiskScore_Weight_Factor   = 100\n| extend RiskFactor_Weight         = 100\n//__WEIGHTED_FACTORS_END__\n        | project SecurityDomain=\"Identity\", Category, Subcategory,\n          AssetName=coalesce(iif(isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists(\"SI_AssetName\", \"\"))), tostring(column_ifexists(\"SI_AssetName\", \"\")), tostring(column_ifexists(\"AssetName\", \"\"))), column_ifexists(\"DisplayName\", \"\")),\n          AssetId=coalesce(iif(isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists(\"SI_AssetId\", \"\"))), tostring(column_ifexists(\"SI_AssetId\", \"\")), tostring(column_ifexists(\"AssetId\", \"\"))), column_ifexists(\"PrimaryEntityId\", \"\")),\n          AssetType=coalesce(column_ifexists(\"AssetType\", \"\"), column_ifexists(\"ObjectType\", \"\"), \"Identity\"),\n          ConfigurationName=DisplayName, ConfigurationId=Upn,\n          Impact=\"External guest holds Entra role assignment\",\n          EntraRoles_Permanent, MoreInfoUrl, Links, SecuritySeverity, CriticalityTier, CriticalityTierLevel, RiskFactor_Consequence, RiskFactor_Probability, RiskFactor_Probability_Detailed, RiskFactor_Weight, RiskScore_Weight_Detailed, RiskScore_Weight_Factor\n\n| sort by RiskFactor_Weight desc"
      ]
    }

{
      "ReportName": "PublicIP_OpenPorts_Detailed",
      "ReportPurpose": "Per-row Detailed view of public-IP open ports. Severity follows the criticality tier of the asset the IP belongs to. One row per (AssetName, IpAddress, Port). Source: SI_PublicIP_Profile_CL (Shodan scanner).
",
      "SecurityDomain": "PublicIP",
      "CategoryInputName": "Category",
      "SubcategoryInputName": "Subcategory",
      "ConfigurationIdInputName": "ConfigurationId",
      "SecuritySeverityInputName": "SecuritySeverity",
      "CriticalityTierLevelInputName": "CriticalityTierLevel",
      "RiskConsequenceScoreOutputName": "RiskConsequenceScore",
      "RiskProbabilityScoreOutputName": "RiskProbabilityScore",
      "RiskScoreOutputName": "RiskScoreTotal",
      "CriticalityTierLevelScope": [
        "Critical - tier 0",
        "High - tier 1",
        "Medium - tier 2",
        "Low - tier 3"
      ],
      "SecuritySeverityScope": [
        "Very High",
        "High",
        "Medium-High",
        "Medium",
        "Low"
      ],
      "OutputPropertyOrder": [
        "SecurityDomain",
        "Category",
        "Subcategory",
        "ConfigurationName",
        "ConfigurationId",
        "AssetName",
        "AssetId",
        "AssetType",
        "Impact",
        "SecuritySeverity",
        "CriticalityTier",
        "CriticalityTierLevel",
        "RiskFactor_Consequence_Detailed",
        "RiskFactor_Consequence",
        "RiskFactor_Probability_Detailed",
        "RiskFactor_Probability",
        "RiskConsequenceScore",
        "RiskProbabilityScore",
        "RiskScoreTotal",
        "RiskScore_Weight_Detailed",
        "RiskScore_Weight_Factor",
        "RiskScoreTotal_Weighted",
        "RiskRating",
        "cmdbId",
        "cmdbName",
        "cmdbCriticality",
        "cmdbDataSensitivity",
        "MoreDetails",
        "AssetDetectedInReportName"
      ],
      "SortBy": [
        "RiskScoreTotal_Weighted"
      ],
      "ReportQuery": [
        "SI_PublicIP_Profile_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
| summarize arg_max(CollectionTime, *) by IpAddress
| where InShodan == true and OpenPortCount > 0
// The table has SI_AssetName and no AssetName column, and it stores cmdbName and
// cmdbCriticality as dynamic, which cannot be a summarize key. Normalise all three here.
| extend AssetName       = iif(isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetName", ""))), tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetName", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AssetName", "")))
| extend cmdbName        = tostring(column_ifexists("cmdbName", ""))
| extend cmdbCriticality = tostring(column_ifexists("cmdbCriticality", ""))
| extend OpenPortsArray = parse_json(OpenPorts)
| mv-expand Port = OpenPortsArray to typeof(int)
| extend IsHighRiskPort = iff(Port in (22, 3389, 1433, 3306, 5432, 5985, 5986), 1, 0)
// Impact -- 0-10, the same scale the CVE reports take from CVSS. Shodan reports no score for
// an open port, so these are the authored values already declared for this domain in
// risk-analysis.schema.locked.json (Open admin port 9.0, Exposed service 7.0). That map was
// never wired into the engine -- nothing loads that file at runtime -- so the numbers are
// emitted here, where the engine actually reads them.
| extend Impact = iff(IsHighRiskPort == 1, 9.0, 7.0)
// CriticalityTier -- the tier of the LINKED ASSET, read from Tier exactly as the other ~76
// reports do. publicip used to read AssetTier here because its Tier column carried the public
// IP object's own (constant) tier; Tier now carries the owning asset's criticality, so this
// matches every other engine and AssetTier is left as a back-compat alias.
| extend CriticalityTier = toint(coalesce(Tier, 99))
| extend CriticalityTierLevel =
    case(CriticalityTier == 0, "Critical - tier 0",
         CriticalityTier == 1, "High - tier 1",
         CriticalityTier == 2, "Medium - tier 2",
         CriticalityTier == 3, "Low - tier 3", "Low - tier 3")
// v2.2.322 -- tier-driven 4-label severity so PublicIP rows bucket
// into Critical/High/Medium/Low dashboard columns same as every other
// engine. Pre-v2.2.322 emitted "Very High"/"High"/"Medium-High"/"Medium"
// which never produced "Critical" (only "Very High" maps there) and
// never produced "Low" -- so PublicIP always showed Critical=0 + Low=0.
// Port-risk + tier-0 escalation now flow through RiskFactor_Probability
// tokens (AdminPort, Tier0Asset) only -- severity label = pure tier.
| extend SecuritySeverity =
    case(CriticalityTier == 0, "Very High",
         CriticalityTier == 1, "High",
         CriticalityTier == 2, "Medium",
         "Low")
| extend SecurityDomain    = "PublicIP"
| extend Category          = "External Exposure"
| extend Subcategory       = "Open Port"
| extend ConfigurationName = strcat("Public IP with open port ", tostring(Port))
| extend ConfigurationId   = strcat("PUBLICIP-OPENPORT-", tostring(Port))
| extend RiskFactor_Consequence = 3   // engine overrides this from RiskFactor_Consequence_Detailed token count (or 0 if empty) -- schema scaffolding only
| extend RiskFactor_Probability = 1 + IsHighRiskPort + iff(CriticalityTier == 0, 1, 0)
//__BUCKET_FILTER_BEGIN__
| where 1 == 1
//__BUCKET_FILTER_END__
//__WEIGHTED_FACTORS_BEGIN__
| extend RiskScore_Weight_Detailed = ""
| extend RiskScore_Weight_Factor   = 100
//__WEIGHTED_FACTORS_END__
| project SecurityDomain, Category, Subcategory, ConfigurationName, ConfigurationId,
          AssetName,
          AssetId = iif(isnotempty(tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetId", ""))), tostring(column_ifexists("SI_AssetId", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AssetId", ""))),
          AssetType,
          Impact, SecuritySeverity, CriticalityTier, CriticalityTierLevel,
          AssetEngine, IpAddress, Port,
          cmdbName, cmdbCriticality, Country,
          OrgName        = tostring(column_ifexists("OrgName", "")),
          Isp            = tostring(column_ifexists("Isp", "")),
          Hostnames,
          ShodanLastSeen = tostring(column_ifexists("ShodanLastSeen", "")),
          RiskFactor_Consequence, RiskFactor_Probability,
          RiskScore_Weight_Detailed, RiskScore_Weight_Factor
| order by RiskScore_Weight_Factor desc, CriticalityTier asc, RiskFactor_Probability desc"
      ]
    }
